test_inputs.explanation: The long `filter/...` segment in the navigated URL contains a base64-like token that decodes to URL-encoded parameters. Decoding yields values such as customer_id[from]=1001, firstname=Jane, email=jane.doe%40example.com, type=c and last_url=%2Fcheckout%2Fcart. 'type=c' corresponds to 'Customer'. No 'to' ID or any session/last-activity date ranges or IP were included, so those fields are left empty.
